note: The debug world's sweep (puck sweep): the tools it runs for a bounded span, the signals it reads, and the capture tour. Rules name a metric, an operator and a value; a red rule makes the signal red, an amber rule amber, and a rule whose metric the answer lacks leaves the signal unmeasured, which fails the run like red. compare says how a metric is judged against a previous report: exact (any change is named), relative:<fraction> (a change beyond that fraction of the old value is named) or none. The headless leg boots paused before its first tick and steps only inside waits, so ticks and tick-counted metrics repeat; only wall-clock metrics (host.frames, host.memory) are not compared exactly. Only cache-independent world.boot counts are compared exactly. Windowed authority is held between calls and advances only over explicit tick waits and pinned captures. A signal marked recheck is read again after the tour.

tools.name: chess-scope
tools.note: The chess table's idle demonstration: the first cycle records its scope tape, the second replays and compares it. It runs after the fuzzer and the traversal bot, whose lift rides recompile the solid consumers, so the sweep shows the scope's restore validating exactly its own rows and bodies.

signals.name: frames-walking
signals.line:
debug.go gallery-level-0
body.fly 1 0 0 0 0 0 4
host.frames reset
world.wait 120
host.frames 120

tour.note: Each stop starts from the reset lines, runs its own, waits for the bakes, and takes a settled capture pinned to a named tick: a start tick a fixed lead after the held tick, plus the stop's settle ticks. Authority stays paused across bake waits and coordinator calls, and pauses again at the capture tick. The frame lines (camera recenter and animation reseed) run at the start tick, and a stop's steps are pinned after it (world.at). Lockstep presentation follows those ticks, so a motion still shows the same tick whatever the bakes cost. Images are compared with the baseline's by changed pixels: a pixel changes when any channel differs by more than the level tolerance, and a still whose changed fraction exceeds the amber fraction is amber.
